messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your account has been suspended due to incorrect validation of your Personal details.', 'During our regularly scheduled account maintenance and verification procedures, we were unable to verify your account information.', 'Recently, our Account Review Team identified some unusual activity in your account.', 'Your online access has been restricted.', 'Bank of America Your Online Banking is Blocked', 'This is your final message to inform you as of 28 - March - 2015 that you have not yet reviewed your Apple Profile information.', 'HSBC Bank is presently unable to process wire transfers.', "We've Limited your account access.", "We've just sent an e-mail to charles_liray2006@yahoo.co.uk to let them know there's a payment waiting for them to collect.", 'I have Paid there registration fee for your Check which has been with me for a long time.', 'Please note that your Lloyds TSB Online Banking Account has been flagged due to recent changes we have made to our online banking system.', 'Our system has detected unusual charges to a credit card linked to your PayPal account.', 'we were unable to verify your account details.', 'Unfortunately, access to your account has been limited.', 'Your online access has been restricted.', 'To help protect our customers we are implementing new security features which will change how you currently log into online banking.', 'We have received your payroll processing request.', 'After the last annual calculations of your fiscal activity, we have determined that you are eligible to receive a tax refund of 4500.00 GBP.', 'Our system detected irregular activity on your HSBC Check Card on 16 February 2010.', 'Your Lloyds TSB Online Password and Memorable Word is revoked, due to invalid logon attempts by a suspected third-party user.', 'You have incorrectly entered your details more than 3 times.', 'We just want to confirm the payment made to your NatWest Credit Card account.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
